intro: Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-08, ZCyberNews published 91 articles tagged supply-chain, spanning activity attributed to Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and Alluring Pisces. Coverage tracked critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-1731 and CVE-2026-45033, both rated CVSS 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-39987 at CVSS 9.3 and the CVSS 6.1 flaws CVE-2026-41650 and CVE-2026-44664. The technology, software development, cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing sectors were most affected, with incidents reported across Global, North america, Europe, United states, and Asia. Severity across the archive comprised 53 high, 16 critical, 16 medium, and 4 informational items.
